common_master_gates.requirement: Read the authoritative [_] item and its attempts from the v2 blueprint exactly once and use compare-and-swap before writing [x].
Require every intra-theorem predecessor [x] and every cross-theorem hard edge to satisfy its typed state_semantics; never use a longest-prefix heuristic.
Resolve an authority-owned per-item role map and bind every selected HEAD artifact by role, path, sha256, and Git blob; names and aliases are not evidence.
Bind one independent read-only Codex app-server /goal review to the exact item, base, contract, prompt, status, worker packet, receipt, and artifact hashes.
Select argv from this HEAD contract, replay the unchanged base validator without shell interpolation in a read-only repository plus isolated scratch, and bind complete output.
Interpret the validator's typed semantic result; exit zero alone never changes blocked, rejected, failed, open, stale, audit_complete, or theorem_complete semantics.
Independently recompute every applicable lifecycle, statement, obligation, composition, provenance, trust, source, readability, metric, and terminal decision gate.
Verify v2 rank, phase states, complete required ancestor inspection, consumed hard-edge material, reuse ledger truthfulness, and fresh dependency context.
Fail on changed, expired, superseded, revoked, stale, cross-target, or unbound evidence and preserve all invalidation inputs in the acceptance receipt.
Regenerate task and public projections from accepted evidence and require a clean diff without rewriting the worker verdict or terminal booleans.
Check PAUSED before review, replay, receipt publication, SSOT CAS, checkpoint commit, and push; publish per-item evidence and state atomically with complete WAL recovery.

Write a content-addressed master receipt that separately preserves worker_verdict, review_verdict, phase_evidence_accepted, audit_complete, theorem_complete, all artifact hashes, replay result, review identity, and status boundary.

phases.completion_semantics: Accept a complete planned-instance intake and open task DAG for one manifest target; exact statement and proof closure may remain explicitly open.
phases.phase_acceptance_claim: The target is in scope, one planned dossier has a bounded claim candidate, profiles/owners/freshness are recorded, and every unresolved choice is exposed without proof credit.
phases.truthful_negative_boundary: A planned intake may preserve null formal-target fields and concrete downstream blockers, but the intake record itself must be complete; a raw failed intake gate remains unfinished.

theorem_boundary.condition: A planned intake contains no accepted proof state.

content_requirements: explicit null/open statement boundary when unresolved

phases.completion_semantics: Accept one exact kernel-elaborated canonical Lean target, environment fingerprint, boundary model, checked alternate transports, and required statement mutations.
phases.phase_acceptance_claim: The selected Lean declaration or expression is the exact canonical mathematical claim in the pinned environment and survives all positive and negative identity checks.
phases.truthful_negative_boundary: Ambiguity, metavariables, a missing expression fingerprint, or a surviving non-equivalent mutation is a statement blocker and cannot close this positive gate.

audit_boundary.condition: Statement identity is one audit input, not AUDIT-Z.

theorem_boundary.condition: Elaborating a proposition is not proving it.

phases.completion_semantics: Accept a replayable bounded discovery protocol and complete truthful classification of every prescribed repo-local, pinned-library, official, public, statement-only, historical, and human-source search lane.
phases.phase_acceptance_claim: Every prescribed candidate and negative search result is content-bound, statement-normalized, provenance/trust classified, and assigned M0-L/M0-W/M0-P/M1/M2/M3/M4/M5 without upgrading evidence.
phases.truthful_negative_boundary: Not-found, access-failed, incompatible, M4, and M5 findings may be accepted as classifications only when the precommitted search lane, evidence, first blocker, and reopen condition are complete; a raw aborted protocol remains unfinished.

audit_boundary.condition: Anchor classification alone does not reconcile the full frozen inventory.

theorem_boundary.condition: A search result or source anchor supplies no root proof credit by itself.

content_requirements: present when any candidate receives machine evidence

phases.completion_semantics: Accept a status-independent frozen obligation denominator, complete mandatory mathematical decomposition, typed reciprocal graphs, substantive leaf ledgers, and checked conditional composition interfaces.
phases.phase_acceptance_claim: Every root-relevant obligation, proof branch, imported boundary, source/readability overlay, workflow task, and composition edge is explicitly modeled without inferring closure from availability.
phases.truthful_negative_boundary: Open proof debt and explicitly modeled blockers may remain, but a missing root, unfrozen denominator, orphan obligation, untyped edge, hidden branch, or invalid composition keeps the architecture phase unfinished.

audit_boundary.condition: Architecture acceptance precedes full evidence/source/readability reconciliation.

theorem_boundary.condition: An obligation graph and conditional composers are not proof bodies.

phases.completion_semantics: Accept the exact requested proof bodies, imports, or checked consumer-owned transports with complete dependency context, provenance, trust, placeholder, axiom, and child-composition evidence.
phases.phase_acceptance_claim: Every proof obligation claimed closed has an exact kernel-checked body under the selected profile, and accepted parent material is reused by content without inheriting acceptance.
phases.truthful_negative_boundary: A dependency blocker, partial body, refutation of an overbroad encoding, or no_state_change packet remains evidence for a repair child unless master replay proves the complete assigned proof predicate; no generic report_open_state exception is inferred from this phase id.

audit_boundary.condition: Proof implementation does not complete source, readability, or evidence reconciliation.

theorem_boundary.condition: Proof-phase acceptance precedes validation and release; it never decides THEOREM-Z.

content_requirements: one decision per edge hint and shared group
no placeholder axiom unsafe or oracle path
terminal body id and statement fingerprint
exact declarations and closed obligation ids
kernel axiom placeholder provenance and composition results

phases.completion_semantics: Accept a complete authority-replayed validation of every claimed declaration, import, transport, composition, trust, provenance, source-boundary, and consumer receipt on the immutable item snapshot.
phases.phase_acceptance_claim: All applicable structured recipes and semantic validation gates for the claimed phase evidence pass, with exact covered obligations/declarations and no blocked, failed, rejected, stale, or open required gate hidden behind process exit zero.
phases.truthful_negative_boundary: A validator may successfully prove a negative packet truthful, but any required semantic result that remains blocked, fail_closed, failed, rejected, stale, or open prevents validation-phase acceptance.

audit_boundary.condition: Validation evidence feeds release; only release decides AUDIT-Z.

theorem_boundary.condition: Validation acceptance is not the terminal THEOREM-Z decision.

content_requirements: required for each accepted hard-edge reuse

phases.completion_semantics: Accept one immutable terminal reconciliation that completes AUDIT-Z and independently records whether THEOREM-Z is true or false; accepted_audit_only closes this phase with theorem_complete=false.
phases.phase_acceptance_claim: The complete frozen inventory, typed graphs, evidence states, source boundaries, debts, open cut set, public projections, and release evidence are reconciled, and the root-completion boolean is supported without hiding an open premise.
phases.truthful_negative_boundary: A fully reconciled audit may accept an honestly open M1-M5 root through accepted_audit_only with audit_complete=true and theorem_complete=false; a raw blocked release recipe or incomplete audit cannot close release.

audit_boundary.condition: Every accepted release, including accepted_audit_only, must establish AUDIT-Z.

theorem_boundary.condition: accepted_audit_only requires false; accepted may set true only after exact M0 root and every root-critical release gate.

content_requirements: immutable clean cold and offline recipes
no shared writable dependency or build cache
